name: Tend demo interaction pack
disclaimer: Demo rule pack only. Not clinical guidance. A clinician decides.

pairs.reason: Trimethoprim can strengthen warfarin. The prescriber should review the dose before the new course continues.
Ibuprofen raises bleeding risk with warfarin. Ask the prescriber for a safer option.
Aspirin adds bleeding risk on top of warfarin. Confirm the combination is intended.
Both affect serotonin. The prescriber should review the combination.
Clarithromycin raises simvastatin levels and the risk of muscle injury. Ask about an alternative antibiotic.
Both raise potassium. A clinician may want a potassium check.
Calcium can reduce levothyroxine absorption. The timing of the doses matters.
Omeprazole can reduce how well clopidogrel works. Ask about another stomach medicine.
Amlodipine raises simvastatin levels. The prescriber may cap the simvastatin dose.
